description: Defines the ViewConnectorSettings class for rendering the connector settings page in SuiteCRM, including methods for module title, tab, and display logic.

classes.name: ViewConnectorSettings
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to handle the display of connector settings in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including a link to the Administration module.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the name of the module tab, 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the connector settings page, assigning language strings and displaying the template.
